text:
maya: @here HUGE news — we just crossed 50M monthly requests on the API!! :tada: :confetti_ball:
sam: omg yes!! that’s insane, massive props to infra + runtime teams :raised_hands: :rocket:
taylor: wow wow wow. official mini-celebration pls. is the office open for a tiny party or should we do a virtual happy hour? poll below.
liam: who’s bringing the playlist? i’ll DJ remotely if you promise no requests for 'that one song' :grin: 
ada: i can order snacks for the office (mini crepes?) and ship a snack box to remote folks. what do people prefer — crepes or savory finger foods? :thinking_face:
maya: love it. quick emoji vote — :one: for in-office pop-up, :two: for remote happy hour kits, :three: for hybrid (office + kits). react to this message.
sam: also can we add a tiny ritual? team cowbell? real cowbell??? :cowbell: (i’ll bring a jingling bell if needed)
liam: tiny ritual approved. also thinking we should snapshot latency/throughput dashboards and pin them to the #eng channel — small writeup on what made this hit possible. cheers to the ops and runtime folks.
ada: ops-bot, can you confirm conference room C availability this Friday 5–6pm for a micro celebration?
ops-bot: ops-bot: Room reservation confirmed for Conference Room C — 2025-11-07 17:00–18:00. AV cart reserved. :white_check_mark:
maya: perfect. remote folks — we’ll send snack + confetti pouch kits. expect a short survey in your inbox to collect addresses.
taylor: playlist here (add your bangers):
```
https://open.spotify.com/playlist/6Gm-example-playlist
```
sam: tiny toast idea: 30s shoutouts. who wants to say one thing about someone who made this happen? i'll start — shoutout to @taylor for juggling the canary yesterday at midnight. saved us. :beers:
ada: shoutout to the infra crew for the batching changes. huge perf wins.
liam: shoutout to maya for the rallying emails and for not letting the ship sink during the rollout.
maya: stop I’m blushing. ok last logistics note — finance will schedule a quick photoshoot (phone pics) for the company feed. no pressured smiles. :camera_with_flash:
sam: :thumbsup: done. see y’all Friday (virtual + IRL). 50M!!! :tada: :beers: :sparkles:
